task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to attempt to move west. After that, go to the north. If you can get around to doing that, travel north. With that done, go east. After that, venture east. And then, venture east. And then, move east. And then, travel south. And then, attempt to venture south. Following that, attempt to take a trip east. If you can accomplish that, head east. And then, make an effort to travel north. And then, make an attempt to move north. And then, go west. After that, attempt to go to the north. Then, travel north. And then, move west. And then, attempt to venture north. Once you manage that, head west. And then, go south. With that accomplished, head south. Then, go to the west. And then, make an effort to move north. Then, attempt to go to the north. And then, make an effort to move east. Next, move east. After that, attempt to go to the east. Okay, and then, try to move north. And then, make an attempt to head west. After that, attempt to travel south. With that over with, attempt to go to the west. Then, head west. After that, make an effort to head west. Then, attempt to take a trip south. With that accomplished, make an attempt to head west. Next, make an effort to head west. If you can manage that, pick-up the coin from the floor of the sleepy bedchamber. And once you've done that, you win!
